column1: # OSBundleRequired per kext (nextbsd-kernel-extensions#4), by role, as Mac OS X 10.9.5 (13F34) tags its kexts.
# Taken from /System/Library/Extensions on a 10.9.5 Mac, including the plugins inside the families:
#   Local-Root    storage controllers, card readers and the layers under a local root
#                 (10.9: AppleAHCIPort, AppleLSIFusionMPT, ATTO SAS/FC, AppleSDXC, AppleRAID, CoreStorage)
#   Network-Root  wired NICs, USB Ethernet chips and Wi-Fi (10.9: IONetworkingFamily's AppleIntel8254XEthernet,
#                 AppleBCM5701Ethernet, AppleYukon2, AppleUSBEthernet, AppleUSBGigEthernet; IO80211Family's AirPort*)
#   Console       keyboards, mice and trackpads (10.9: AppleHIDKeyboard, AppleHIDMouse, IOUSBHIDDriver,
#   Safe Boot     SMBus controllers, SMC and sensors, backlight, Bluetooth, autofs (10.9: AppleSMBusController,
#                 AppleSMBusPCI, AppleSMC, AppleHWSensor, AppleBacklight, IOBluetoothFamily, autofs)
# Kexts not listed carry no key, as 10.9 leaves USB CDC Ethernet and tethering (AppleUSBCDCECM, AppleUSBEthernetHost),
# USB serial (AppleUSBFTDI, AppleUSBCDCACM), raw HID, audio and the non-root filesystems without one.
# The value matters only to a pre-root load path (the boot loader preloading kexts, e.g. for a ZFS root);
# after root, kextd loads everything on demand regardless. A ZFS-root kext would add Root.
